newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank 2-week rev repo ave yield 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank 2-week rev repo ave yield 16 pct.

text.p: Average yield at the Czech central bank's (CNB) two-week reverse repo tender to drain market liquidity on Wednesday hit the maximum rate of 16 percent, the CNB said.

It added that all bids at the average yield, which was also the maximum rate, were satisfied. The maximum rate in a similar operation on Tuesday was set at 16.2 percent, but the tender attracted no bids.
The CNB does not reveal the amount of funds it drains in its open market operations.
